decisions.reason: Real security event: Cyberscoop reports Citrix confirmed active exploitation of NetScaler zero-days CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 after a weekend of unofficial warnings. Substantive advisory with confirmed exploitation.

CVE-2026-88771.evidence: Event states attackers were actively exploiting and Citrix published advisory confirming exploitation after a weekend of unofficial warnings from CERTs and watchTowr.

CVE-2026-88772.evidence: Same confirmation in event: actively exploited zero-day patched by Citrix, with CVE-2026-88772 named as one of the exploited flaws.

decisions.reason: Real ransomware breach: Keio Corporation confirms ransomware disrupted corporate systems and shut down network. Fits existing Keio breach story.
